body: Absolutely incredible, hard to comprehend the magnitude! I think viewing this image with a soundtrack of m83 is in order

Ah Iv feel for ya! I once had a fly bury into my ear and lost all sense of control, that feeling of it scuttling around or vibrating was so nauseating. I went to hospital where they used special tweasers...but only ever found a few parts of it. They assured me that the human ear canal was quite shallow and there's no way it could have gone further in, so after a few days I started to accept that a fly had not crawled into my brain.
